role: Independent symbolic simplification of four rational identities
command: With[{a=1/(1+t), af=1/(1+2t)}, FullSimplify[{a^2-af+t^2/((1+t)^2(1+2t)), a^2+a-2af-t/((1+t)^2(1+2t)), ct w/p-ct(w-dw)/(p-de)-(ct dw-(ct w/p)de)/(p-de), eta s1/(1+eta s1)^2-eta s2/(1+eta s2)^2-eta(s1-s2)(1-eta^2 s1 s2)/((1+eta s1)^2(1+eta s2)^2)}, Assumptions->{t>=0,p>de,p>0,eta>=0,s1>s2>0}]]
